fusions.name: Surfacing Bite
fusions.desc: Comes up under an enemy up to 4 tiles away and bites for 8 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, leaving it [Soaked] for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Ditchwater Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks foul water off your coat at every enemy within 2 tiles, dealing 3 damage with a 30% chance to leave each [Weakened] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bob Up Elsewhere
fusions.desc: You dive and come up at a point up to 5 tiles away, and have 8% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Off the Oiled Coat
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it. You have 8% water resistance.
